correctness.rationale: The support-union lemma applies to two different descendants, so every conflict lies entirely within one exact alphabet support. Seven canonical support graphs cover all n=3,4 alphabet-size possibilities, regardless of q. Each included independent-set certificate and disjoint-edge matching certificate is reconstructed and checked by a standalone standard-library program. A matching of size v−a gives alpha≤a, while the independent set gives alpha≥a. Summation by binomial support counts proves the two exact formulas for every integer q≥2. All quantifiers, distinctness and low-read exclusions are stated.
